LanguageData.Gun_Thompson_UMP40_RWP.description: The UMP40 is a lightweight submachine gun known for its high fire rate and reliable performance. Chambered for .40 caliber rounds, it delivers significant stopping power in a compact form. Ideal for close-quarters combat, the UMP40 balances firepower and maneuverability, making it a favored choice among colony defenders.
